tgbroadcast.admin.intro.ha: Rubuta saƙo don sakawa a tashoshinmu na Telegram, ko don aika wa masu bin gasa kai tsaye, ko duka biyun. Rubutu mara ado: ana kiyaye sabbin layuka kuma ba a tsara komai ba. Ba za a aika komai ba sai ka rubuta SEND ka danna Aika saƙon.
tgbroadcast.admin.intro.ig: Dee ozi ị ga-etinye n'ọwa Telegram anyị, ma ọ bụ ziga ya kpọmkwem nye ndị na-eso asọmpi, ma ọ bụ ha abụọ. Ederede nkịtị: a na-edebe ahịrị ọhụrụ, ọ dịghịkwa ihe a na-ahazi. Ọ dịghị ihe a ga-eziga ruo mgbe ị dere SEND ma pịa Ziga ozi.
tgbroadcast.admin.intro.yo: Kọ ìfiránṣẹ́ láti gbé sórí àwọn ìkànnì Telegram wa, láti fi ránṣẹ́ tààrà sí àwọn tó ń tẹ̀lé ìdíje, tàbí méjèèjì. Ọ̀rọ̀ lásán: a ó pa àwọn ìlà tuntun mọ́, a kì í sì ṣe àtúnṣe ìrísí kankan. Kò sí ohun tí a ó fi ránṣẹ́ títí o fi tẹ SEND tí o sì tẹ Fi ìfiránṣẹ́ ránṣẹ́.

tgbroadcast.admin.target-channels.ha: Saka a tashoshinmu na Telegram, kowane harshe a tasharsa
tgbroadcast.admin.target-channels.ig: Tinye n'ọwa Telegram anyị, asụsụ ọ bụla n'ọwa nke ya
tgbroadcast.admin.target-channels.yo: Gbé e sórí àwọn ìkànnì Telegram wa, èdè kọ̀ọ̀kan sí ìkànnì tirẹ̀

tgbroadcast.admin.target-followers.ha: Haka kuma aika wa masu bin gasa saƙo kai tsaye, kowa da harshensa, a hankali, sau ɗaya a kowane saƙo
tgbroadcast.admin.target-followers.ig: Zigakwa ozi kpọmkwem nye ndị na-eso asọmpi, onye ọ bụla n'asụsụ ya, nwayọọ nwayọọ, otu ugboro maka ozi ọ bụla
tgbroadcast.admin.target-followers.yo: Tún fi ìfiránṣẹ́ tààrà ránṣẹ́ sí àwọn tó ń tẹ̀lé ìdíje, olúkúlùkù ní èdè rẹ̀, díẹ̀díẹ̀, lẹ́ẹ̀kan ṣoṣo fún ìfiránṣẹ́ kọ̀ọ̀kan

tgbroadcast.admin.confirm-label.yo: Tẹ SEND láti fìdí rẹ̀ múlẹ̀

tgbroadcast.admin.reason-confirm.ha: Rubuta SEND a cikin akwatin don tabbatarwa.
tgbroadcast.admin.reason-confirm.ig: Dee SEND n'igbe ahụ iji kwado.
tgbroadcast.admin.reason-confirm.yo: Tẹ SEND sínú àpótí náà láti fìdí rẹ̀ múlẹ̀.

tgbroadcast.admin.reason-too-long.yo: Ìfiránṣẹ́ {lang} ti ju ohun kikọ {max} lọ.

tgbroadcast.admin.reason-no-target.ha: Zaɓi inda za a aika: tashoshinmu, masu bin gasa, ko duka biyun.
tgbroadcast.admin.reason-no-target.ig: Họrọ ebe ị ga-eziga ya: ọwa anyị, ndị na-eso, ma ọ bụ ha abụọ.
tgbroadcast.admin.reason-no-target.yo: Yan ibi tí o fẹ́ fi ránṣẹ́ sí: àwọn ìkànnì wa, àwọn tó ń tẹ̀lé, tàbí méjèèjì.

tgbroadcast.admin.reason-not-live.ha: Tashoshinmu na Telegram ba sa aiki, don haka ba za a iya saka komai a can ba.
tgbroadcast.admin.reason-not-live.ig: Ọwa Telegram anyị anaghị arụ ọrụ, ya mere enweghị ike itinye ihe ọ bụla ebe ahụ.
tgbroadcast.admin.reason-not-live.yo: Àwọn ìkànnì Telegram wa kò ṣiṣẹ́, nítorí náà a kò lè gbé ohunkóhun síbẹ̀.

tgbroadcast.admin.reason-no-followers.ha: Babu mai bin gasa da ya haɗa Telegram, don haka babu wanda za a aika wa saƙo.
tgbroadcast.admin.reason-no-followers.ig: Ọ dịghị onye na-eso asọmpi jikọrọ Telegram, ya mere ọ dịghị onye a ga-ezigara ozi.
tgbroadcast.admin.reason-no-followers.yo: Kò sí ẹni tó ń tẹ̀lé ìdíje tó so Telegram pọ̀, nítorí náà kò sí ẹni tí a lè fi ránṣẹ́ sí.

tgbroadcast.admin.placeholder-en.ha: Rubuta saƙon. Danna Enter don sabon layi.
tgbroadcast.admin.placeholder-en.ig: Dee ozi ahụ. Pịa Enter maka ahịrị ọhụrụ.
tgbroadcast.admin.placeholder-en.yo: Kọ ìfiránṣẹ́ náà. Tẹ Enter fún ìlà tuntun.

tgbroadcast.admin.placeholder-other.ha: Ba dole ba ne. Idan ka bar shi babu komai, masu karatun {lang} za su samu saƙon Turanci.
tgbroadcast.admin.placeholder-other.ig: Ọ bụghị iwu. Ọ bụrụ na ị hapụ ya efu, ndị na-agụ {lang} ga-enweta ozi Bekee.
tgbroadcast.admin.placeholder-other.yo: Kò pọn dandan. Tí o bá fi sílẹ̀ lófo, àwọn òǹkàwé {lang} yóò gba ìfiránṣẹ́ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.

tgbroadcast.admin.chars-over.ha: Ya yi tsawo da yawa ga saƙon Telegram ɗaya.
tgbroadcast.admin.chars-over.ig: Ọ dị ogologo karịa maka otu ozi Telegram.
tgbroadcast.admin.chars-over.yo: Ó gùn jù fún ìfiránṣẹ́ Telegram kan.

tgbroadcast.admin.en-required.ha: Turanci dole ne. Duk harshen da aka bar shi babu komai zai samu saƙon Turanci.
tgbroadcast.admin.en-required.ig: Bekee dị mkpa. Asụsụ ọ bụla a hapụrụ efu ga-enweta ozi Bekee.
tgbroadcast.admin.en-required.yo: Gẹ̀ẹ́sì pọn dandan. Èdè èyíkéyìí tí a fi sílẹ̀ lófo yóò gba ìfiránṣẹ́ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.

tgbroadcast.admin.empty-fallback.ha: Babu komai: masu karatun {lang} za su samu saƙon Turanci.
tgbroadcast.admin.empty-fallback.ig: Efu: ndị na-agụ {lang} ga-enweta ozi Bekee.
tgbroadcast.admin.empty-fallback.yo: Ó ṣófo: àwọn òǹkàwé {lang} yóò gba ìfiránṣẹ́ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.

tgbroadcast.admin.last-none.ha: Ba a aika saƙo ga kowa daga na'urar gudanarwa ba tukuna.
tgbroadcast.admin.last-none.ig: Ezibeghị ozi izugbe site na njikwa.
tgbroadcast.admin.last-none.yo: A kò tíì fi ìfiránṣẹ́ gbogbogbò ránṣẹ́ láti kọ́nsólù.

tgbroadcast.admin.last-running.ha: Ana aikawa: saƙonni {posted} a tasha, an aika saƙonni kai tsaye {sent} cikin {audience}, {failed} sun kasa. Kana iya rufe wannan shafi; sabar za ta ci gaba.
tgbroadcast.admin.last-running.ig: A na-eziga: ozi {posted} n'ọwa, ezigala ozi kpọmkwem {sent} n'ime {audience}, {failed} dara. Ị nwere ike imechi peeji a; sava ga-aga n'ihu.
tgbroadcast.admin.last-running.yo: A ń fi ránṣẹ́: ìfiránṣẹ́ {posted} sórí ìkànnì, a ti fi ìfiránṣẹ́ tààrà {sent} nínú {audience} ránṣẹ́, {failed} kùnà. O lè pa ojú-ìwé yìí dé; sáfà yóò máa bá a lọ.

tgbroadcast.admin.last-done.ha: Saƙon ƙarshe ya kammala: saƙonni {posted} a tasha, an aika saƙonni kai tsaye {sent} cikin {audience}, {failed} sun kasa.
tgbroadcast.admin.last-done.ig: Ozi ikpeazụ agwụla: ozi {posted} n'ọwa, ezigala ozi kpọmkwem {sent} n'ime {audience}, {failed} dara.
tgbroadcast.admin.last-done.yo: Ìfiránṣẹ́ tó kẹ́yìn ti parí: ìfiránṣẹ́ {posted} sórí ìkànnì, a fi ìfiránṣẹ́ tààrà {sent} nínú {audience} ránṣẹ́, {failed} kùnà.

tgbroadcast.admin.last-interrupted.ha: Saƙon ƙarshe ya tsaya saboda sabar ta sake farawa: saƙonni kai tsaye {delivered} sun isa, {waiting} suna jira. Ci gaba da shi don isa ga sauran. Babu wanda zai samu sau biyu.
tgbroadcast.admin.last-interrupted.ig: Ozi ikpeazụ kwụsịrị n'ihi na sava malitere ọzọ: ozi kpọmkwem {delivered} ruru, {waiting} ka na-eche. Gaa n'ihu iji ruo ndị fọdụrụ. Ọ dịghị onye ga-enweta ya ugboro abụọ.
tgbroadcast.admin.last-interrupted.yo: Ìfiránṣẹ́ tó kẹ́yìn dúró nítorí sáfà tún bẹ̀rẹ̀: ìfiránṣẹ́ tààrà {delivered} ti dé, {waiting} ṣì ń dúró. Tẹ̀síwájú láti dé ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn tó kù. Kò sí ẹni tí yóò gbà á lẹ́ẹ̀mejì.

tgbroadcast.admin.last-failed.ha: Saƙon ƙarshe ya tsaya da kuskure ({error}). {waiting} suna jira.
tgbroadcast.admin.last-failed.ig: Ozi ikpeazụ kwụsịrị na njehie ({error}). {waiting} ka na-eche.
tgbroadcast.admin.last-failed.yo: Ìfiránṣẹ́ tó kẹ́yìn dúró pẹ̀lú àṣìṣe ({error}). {waiting} ṣì ń dúró.

tgbroadcast.admin.channels-live.yo: Àwọn ìkànnì Telegram wa ti ń ṣiṣẹ́.

tgbroadcast.admin.totals.ha: saƙonni {posts} a tasha · saƙonni kai tsaye {dms}

tgbroadcast.admin.preview-empty.ha: Rubuta saƙon Turanci don ganin abin da kowane mai karatu zai samu.
tgbroadcast.admin.preview-empty.ig: Dee ozi Bekee iji hụ ihe onye ọgụgụ ọ bụla ga-enweta.
tgbroadcast.admin.preview-empty.yo: Kọ ìfiránṣẹ́ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì láti rí ohun tí òǹkàwé kọ̀ọ̀kan yóò gbà.

tgbroadcast.admin.no-own-channel.ha: Babu tashar kansa, don haka ba a saka komai don wannan harshe.
tgbroadcast.admin.no-own-channel.ig: Enweghị ọwa nke ya, ya mere ọ dịghị ihe a na-etinye maka asụsụ a.
tgbroadcast.admin.no-own-channel.yo: Kò ní ìkànnì tirẹ̀, nítorí náà a kò gbé nǹkan kan fún èdè yìí.

tgbroadcast.admin.followers-get.ha: Masu bin gasa {n} za su samu shi a matsayin saƙo kai tsaye
tgbroadcast.admin.followers-get.ig: Ndị na-eso {n} ga-enweta ya dịka ozi kpọmkwem
tgbroadcast.admin.followers-get.yo: Àwọn tó ń tẹ̀lé {n} yóò gbà á gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìfiránṣẹ́ tààrà

tgbroadcast.admin.waiting-note.ha: Masu bin gasa {waiting} ba su samu ba (misali, mutanen da suka toshe bot ɗin, ko waɗanda suka fara bi daga baya). Ci gaba zai sake gwada su kaɗai.
tgbroadcast.admin.waiting-note.ig: Ndị na-eso {waiting} enwetabeghị ya (dịka ọmụmaatụ, ndị gbochiri bot ahụ, ma ọ bụ ndị bidoro iso mgbe e mesịrị). Ịga n'ihu ga-anwale naanị ha ọzọ.
tgbroadcast.admin.waiting-note.yo: Àwọn tó ń tẹ̀lé {waiting} kò tíì gbà á (fún àpẹẹrẹ, àwọn tó dí bot náà, tàbí àwọn tó bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí í tẹ̀lé lẹ́yìn náà). Títẹ̀síwájú yóò tún gbìyànjú àwọn nìkan.

tgbroadcast.admin.refused-sent.ha: An riga an aika wannan saƙon. Duba saƙon ƙarshe a ƙasa; ka sake rubuta SEND kawai idan kana son aika shi sau biyu.
tgbroadcast.admin.refused-sent.ig: Ezigalarị ozi a. Lelee ozi ikpeazụ n'okpuru; dee SEND ọzọ naanị ma ọ bụrụ na ị chọrọ iziga ya ugboro abụọ.
tgbroadcast.admin.refused-sent.yo: A ti fi ìfiránṣẹ́ yìí ránṣẹ́ tẹ́lẹ̀. Wo ìfiránṣẹ́ tó kẹ́yìn nísàlẹ̀; tún tẹ SEND kìkì bí o bá fẹ́ fi ránṣẹ́ lẹ́ẹ̀mejì.

tgbroadcast.admin.refused-nothing.ha: Babu abin da ya rage a aika don wannan saƙon.
tgbroadcast.admin.refused-nothing.ig: Ọ dịghị ihe fọdụrụ iziga maka ozi ahụ.
tgbroadcast.admin.refused-nothing.yo: Kò sí ohun tó kù láti fi ránṣẹ́ fún ìfiránṣẹ́ náà.

tgbroadcast.admin.refused-not-found.ha: Ba a sami wannan saƙon ba. Sabunta.
tgbroadcast.admin.refused-not-found.yo: A kò rí ìfiránṣẹ́ náà. Sọ ọ́ dọ̀tun.

tgbroadcast.admin.started.ha: An fara: saƙonni {posts} a tasha da saƙonni kai tsaye {dms}.
tgbroadcast.admin.started.ig: Amalitela: ozi {posts} n'ọwa na ozi kpọmkwem {dms}.
tgbroadcast.admin.started.yo: Ó ti bẹ̀rẹ̀: ìfiránṣẹ́ {posts} sórí ìkànnì àti ìfiránṣẹ́ tààrà {dms}.

tgbroadcast.admin.resumed.ha: An ci gaba: saƙonni {posts} a tasha da saƙonni kai tsaye {dms}.
tgbroadcast.admin.resumed.ig: Agala n'ihu: ozi {posts} n'ọwa na ozi kpọmkwem {dms}.
tgbroadcast.admin.resumed.yo: A ti tẹ̀síwájú: ìfiránṣẹ́ {posts} sórí ìkànnì àti ìfiránṣẹ́ tààrà {dms}.

tgbroadcast.admin.load-error.ha: Ba a iya loda saƙon ba ({error}).
tgbroadcast.admin.load-error.ig: Enweghị ike ibugo ozi izugbe a ({error}).
tgbroadcast.admin.load-error.yo: Kò ṣeé gbé ìfiránṣẹ́ gbogbogbò wá ({error}).

tgnotice.admin.reason-not-live.ha: Sanarwar tasha ba ta aiki ba, don haka ba za a iya aika sanarwar ba.
tgnotice.admin.reason-not-live.ig: Ọkwa ọwa anaghị arụ ọrụ, ya mere enweghị ike iziga ọkwa a.
tgnotice.admin.reason-not-live.yo: Ìkìlọ̀ ìkànnì kò tíì ṣiṣẹ́, nítorí náà a kò lè fi ìkéde náà ránṣẹ́.

tgnotice.admin.reason-nobody.ha: Babu wanda ke jiran wannan sanarwa.
tgnotice.admin.reason-nobody.ig: Ọ dịghị onye na-eche ọkwa a.
tgnotice.admin.reason-nobody.yo: Kò sí ẹni tó ń dúró de ìkéde yìí.
